nodes.name: Loss Functions
nodes.description: Pure NumPy loss functions for deep learning competition pipelines

nodes.name: miss_penalty_loss
nodes.description: Penalty for positive examples predicted below a confidence threshold
nodes.type_signature: (predictions: NDArray[np.float64], labels: NDArray[np.float64], threshold: float = 0.03) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computes a linear penalty for positive targets predicted below confidence threshold in linear time over N samples.

nodes.name: qwk_loss
nodes.description: Differentiable quadratic weighted kappa loss for ordinal class probabilities
nodes.type_signature: (predictions: NDArray[np.float64], targets: NDArray[np.int64], num_classes: int) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computes quadratic weighted kappa loss over batch B and classes C using pairwise weight and confusion matrices.

nodes.name: ctc_loss
nodes.description: Log-space CTC negative log-likelihood with blank label zero
nodes.type_signature: (log_probs: NDArray[np.float64], targets: NDArray[np.int64], input_lengths: NDArray[np.int64], target_lengths: NDArray[np.int64]) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computes CTC loss via forward-backward dynamic programming over sequence length T, batch size B, and vocabulary V.

nodes.name: focal_loss
nodes.description: Binary focal loss that down-weights easy examples
nodes.type_signature: (predictions: NDArray[np.float64], targets: NDArray[np.float64], alpha: float = 0.25, gamma: float = 2.0) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computes binary focal loss element-wise over predictions of size N in linear time and space.

nodes.name: lovasz_softmax_loss
nodes.description: Lovasz extension surrogate for Jaccard overlap loss
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computes the Lovasz extension of the Jaccard index using sorting over C classes for batch size B.

nodes.name: dice_loss
nodes.description: Soft Dice loss for probability and target masks
nodes.type_signature: (predictions: NDArray[np.float64], targets: NDArray[np.float64], smooth: float = 1e-6) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computes the intersection and union of predictions and targets of size N in linear time.

nodes.name: crps_score
nodes.description: Discrete CRPS between predicted CDFs and observed bin indices
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computes discrete Continuous Ranked Probability Score over B samples with C CDF bins.

nodes.name: contrastive_loss
nodes.description: Pairwise contrastive embedding loss with a margin for different pairs
nodes.type_signature: (embedding_a: NDArray[np.float64], embedding_b: NDArray[np.float64], labels: NDArray[np.float64], margin: float) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computes pairwise contrastive loss over B embedding pairs of dimension D in linear time.

nodes.name: triplet_loss
nodes.description: Margin loss over aligned anchor, positive, and negative embeddings
nodes.type_signature: (anchor: NDArray[np.float64], positive: NDArray[np.float64], negative: NDArray[np.float64], margin: float) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computes margin triplet loss over aligned anchor, positive, and negative vectors of shape (B, D).

nodes.name: label_smoothing_ce
nodes.description: Categorical cross-entropy with one-hot labels mixed with uniform mass
nodes.type_signature: (logits: NDArray[np.float64], targets: NDArray[np.int64], epsilon: float) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Mixes one-hot labels with uniform mass and computes cross-entropy over batch size B and C classes.

nodes.name: weighted_multitask_loss
nodes.description: Fixed weighted sum of scalar task losses
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computes a weighted sum of T scalar task losses in linear time and constant auxiliary space.

nodes.name: multimodal_nll_loss
nodes.type_signature: (ground_truth: NDArray[np.float64], trajectories: NDArray[np.float64], confidences: NDArray[np.float64]) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computes mixture trajectory negative log-likelihood over B batches, M modes, T timesteps, and D coordinates.

nodes.name: weighted_bce_loss
nodes.description: Stable binary cross-entropy with per-sample non-negative weights
nodes.type_signature: (logits: NDArray[np.float64], targets: NDArray[np.float64], weights: NDArray[np.float64]) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computes stable binary cross-entropy element-wise with per-sample weights over arrays of size N.

nodes.name: quantile_spread_to_confidence
nodes.description: Convert quantile spread to clipped confidence interval width
nodes.type_signature: (q_low: NDArray[np.float64], q_high: NDArray[np.float64], min_sigma: float = 70.0) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Converts and clips lower/upper quantile spreads of size N in linear time and space.
